After search_inventory, to confirm a vehicle is still available before pointing a user at it, or to get a payment estimate.

<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

200.description:
Buy Online status for up to 24 VINs (Available, PendingSale, Sold, Deleted) and, for Available vehicles, the site's financing estimate (monthly payment, APR, taxes and fees) for the given down payment, term and credit score (defaults: 2000 USD, 60 months, 825, what the site's own page assumes first). VINs Buy Online does not know are listed in unknown_vins; not found when it knows none.

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description:
After search_inventory or suggest_inventory, or when the user pastes a hertzcarsales.com/used/... or /rent2buy/... URL or a VIN.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

uuid.description: 32-hex vehicle id from a listing row or detail URL. Pattern: ^[0-9a-fA-F]{32}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Read one vehicle by VIN, 32-hex vehicle id (uuid) or its hertzcarsales.com detail URL: everything a search row has plus the specification categories (powertrain, dimensions, safety, warranty, ...) and packages. Looks in the used inventory first and the Rent2Buy fleet second (a URL fixes the inventory). Not found when neither inventory lists it (sold or removed).

The response contains the tool result directly.

post.description:
To discover what exists before searching (which makes, which states have stores, the price range), or to narrow a large result set.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

condition.description:
Which inventory: used (retail used cars, default) or rent2buy (Hertz Rent2Buy rental fleet).

Provider reference: allowed values ["used", "rent2buy"].

make.description: Make names as the site spells them (facet make), e.g. ['Toyota'].

odometer_max.description:
Mileage bounds in miles, inclusive.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

price_max.description:
Internet price bounds in whole US dollars, inclusive.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

radius_miles.description:
Search radius in miles around zip (geoRadius); needs zip. The site's own menu offers 5, 25, 50, 100, 200, 250, 500 and 1000.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5000.

sort.description:
Sort order, passed to the site as its own sort expression (e.g. internetPrice asc). The site's store/make boost order can still interleave rows; without sort the site's default order applies.

Provider reference: allowed values ["price_asc", "price_desc", "year_asc", "year_desc", "odometer_asc", "odometer_desc", "newest"].

state.description: Two-letter US states of the holding store (facet accountState).

year_max.description:
Model-year bounds, inclusive; sent as the list of years in the range (the API rejects a min-max year range).

Provider reference: minimum 1980; maximum 2100.

zip.description: US ZIP code to measure distance from (geoZip). Alone it only fills distance_miles (every match nationwide is kept); with radius_miles it restricts the search. Without it distance_miles is null. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
Facet values with counts for a filter set, from the listing page's inline state: states and cities with stores, makes, models, trims, body styles, fuel types, colours, drive lines, options, and the year, price and mileage ranges of the matching vehicles. Values are the strings search_inventory accepts.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `applied_filters` | object[] | The filters the page applied, as it labels them. |
| `condition` | string |  |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `facets` | object[] |  |
| `listing_url` | string |  |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `resolved_zip` | string | ZIP the server measured distance from: the given zip, else one resolved from the exit IP. |
| `total_count` | number |  |

post.description:
Start here to find vehicles; pass next_cursor back as cursor for the following page. Use list_facets to see which makes, models, states and ranges exist.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.

Mileage bounds in miles, inclusive.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

Internet price bounds in whole US dollars, inclusive.

Provider reference: minimum 0.

Search radius in miles around zip (geoRadius); needs zip. The site's own menu offers 5, 25, 50, 100, 200, 250, 500 and 1000.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 5000.

year_max.description:
Model-year bounds, inclusive; sent as the list of years in the range (the API rejects a min-max year range).

Provider reference: minimum 1980; maximum 2100.

zip.description: US ZIP code to measure distance from (geoZip). Alone it only fills distance_miles (every match nationwide is kept); with radius_miles it restricts the search. Without it distance_miles is null. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

200.description:
Search Hertz Car Sales inventory (used retail cars, or the Rent2Buy rental fleet) by make, model, trim, body style, fuel type, drive line, colour, store state or city, ZIP radius, model-year range, mileage and price, sorted and paged (24 per page by default, 48 at most). Each row carries the vehicle id and VIN for get_vehicle and check_availability, price, mileage, colours, powertrain, photos, the holding store and the distance from the ZIP.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| --- | --- | --- |

| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `listing_url` | string | The public listing page showing this filter set and offset. |
| `next_cursor` | string | Offset of the next page; null when the page is the last one. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `page_start` | number |  |
| `query` | object |  |
| `stores` | object[] | The stores holding vehicles on this page (the response's accounts map). |
| `total_count` | number | Vehicles matching the filters across all pages. |
| `vehicles` | object[] |  |

post.description:
To turn a user's phrase into make/model facets for search_inventory, or for a quick first look at matching cars.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
Usage-based billing; Default request estimate: $0.0005 USD (not a fixed price). Account-specific pricing and final settlement may differ.
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

postal_code.description: Optional US ZIP the site may use for location hints. Pattern: ^[0-9]{5}$.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

200.description:
The site's natural-language inventory search: a free-text query such as 'toyota camry' or 'hybrid suv under 25000' is interpreted into facets (make, model, ...) with matching vehicle cards and facet suggestions. The interpretation is the site's; an unmapped query legitimately returns no vehicles with a justification.

The response contains the tool result directly.

| Documented field | Provider type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `confidence` | number | The site's confidence in its interpretation, 0..1. |
| `count` | number |  |
| `country` | string |  |
| `currency` | string |  |
| `interpreted_facets` | object | The site's natural-language interpretation as facet id -> values (nlsFacets), passed through. |
| `justification` | string | The site's one-line explanation of its interpretation. |
| `observed_at_ms` | number |  |
| `query` | string |  |
| `suggestions` | object[] |  |
| `vehicles` | object[] | Matching vehicle cards; empty when the site could not map the query to inventory. |


These are the provider's documented fields. Field requiredness, nullability and nested object structures are specified only where the descriptions explicitly say so.
